atoms.exact_source_text: MEDIAN distinguishes six principal written forms:
atoms.normalized_claim: MEDIAN distinguishes six principal written forms.

atoms.exact_source_text: | **Initial Caps** | A Defined Term with stable MEDIAN meaning | Citizen, Place, Body Unit, Exposure |
atoms.normalized_claim: Initial Caps marks a Defined Term with a stable MEDIAN meaning, e.g., Citizen, Place, Body Unit, Exposure.

atoms.exact_source_text: | **ALL CAPS** | A canonical experiential operator | DWELL, TRAVEL, RISK, MEET, EMBODY |
atoms.normalized_claim: ALL CAPS marks a canonical experiential operator, e.g., DWELL, TRAVEL, RISK, MEET, EMBODY.

atoms.exact_source_text: | **ALL CAPS species operator** | A civilization's characteristic spatial action | JOIN, GATHER, CONNECT |
atoms.normalized_claim: ALL CAPS species operator marks a civilization's characteristic spatial action, e.g., JOIN, GATHER, CONNECT.
Dot-delimited UpperCamelCase marks a MEDIAN Semantic Identifier, e.g., Away.Crossing.Phase.Planning.

atoms.exact_source_text: | **Hyphen-bound compound** | One translated animal-language word rendered through several English elements | After-name, Prior-life Tale |
atoms.normalized_claim: Hyphen-bound compounds render one translated animal-language word through several English elements, e.g., After-name, Prior-life Tale.

atoms.exact_source_text: | *Defined text treatment* | A stable authored-text function, once established | *mechanics-teaching Narrative snippet* |
atoms.normalized_claim: Defined text treatment marks a stable authored-text function once established, e.g., mechanics-teaching Narrative snippet.

atoms.exact_source_text: A seventh grammatical convention governs Core-Species prose:
atoms.normalized_claim: A seventh grammatical convention governs Core-Species prose.

atoms.exact_source_text: | **Bare Core-Species Singular** | One archetypal Core-Species body expresses the characteristic logic of the species | Mouse builds a Manor House. |
atoms.normalized_claim: Bare Core-Species Singular construction has one archetypal Core-Species body express the characteristic logic of the species, e.g., 'Mouse builds a Manor House.'

atoms.exact_source_text: A noun or noun phrase receives **Initial Caps** when MEDIAN gives it a stable, defined game meaning that differs from, narrows, or formalizes ordinary English usage.
atoms.normalized_claim: A noun or noun phrase receives Initial Caps when MEDIAN assigns it a stable, defined game meaning that differs from, narrows, or formalizes ordinary English usage.
